stone_axe.name: Stone Axe
stone_axe.desc: Weapon. Raises your damage and a squad member's Combat Power.

stone_spear.name: Stone Spear
stone_spear.desc: Weapon. Better damage and Combat Power.

sling.name: Sling
sling.desc: Weapon. Press R to fire stones far and hard; weak up close.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.desc: Off-hand. Blocks some hits outright, and a little armor for a squad member.

scout_hood.name: Scout's Hood
scout_hood.desc: Head. Sharper eyes: +1 PER for a squad member.

hide_cap.name: Hide Cap
hide_cap.desc: Head. Takes the edge off a blow.

hide_armor.name: Hide Armor
hide_armor.desc: Body. Lowers injury chance on expeditions and the damage you take.

hide_gloves.name: Hide Gloves
hide_gloves.desc: Hands. You gather faster; a squad member gathers better.

fiber_sandals.name: Fiber Sandals
fiber_sandals.desc: Feet. A little quicker on your feet.

hide_boots.name: Hide Boots
hide_boots.desc: Feet. Quicker on your feet; a squad member explores better.

cook_food.name: Cook Food (at Campfire)
cook_food.desc: Turn raw food into cooked food (restores more Hunger)

supplies.name: Expedition Supplies ×2
supplies.desc: Packed rations and rope. Each squad member uses one per expedition.

wildwood_spear.name: Wildwood Spear
wildwood_spear.desc: Weapon made from Enchanted Wood. Strong Combat Power.

verdant_cloak.name: Verdant Cloak
verdant_cloak.desc: Body. Lined with Verdant Silk: strong protection, and the squad meets fewer ambushes.
